provenance.scope: TorrServer HTTP emulation only; no engine, Web GUI or management API

indexing.stream_link: 1-based; legacy nonpositive values fall back to first file
indexing.play_alias: 1-based; legacy nonpositive values fall back to first file
indexing.stream_hash_shortcut: internal 0-based unless link parameter is also present
indexing.file_stats: internal index + 1, preserving gaps; nil entries skipped
indexing.plugin_target: explicit payload-only mapping, no legacy nonpositive fallback

adopt: JSON body accepted despite form Content-Type
data is opaque JSON text, not an embedded object
binary Range and DLNA streaming headers
do_not_copy_blindly: stat is an internal string state in this snapshot, not verified original TorrServer DTO
viewed unconditionally returns status ok without parsing or persistence
cache PiecesLength/PiecesCount=0, Pieces={}, Readers=[] are placeholders
legacy hash= uses different indices from link=
HEAD preload has no method guard before warmup scheduling
playlist uses untrusted Host rather than configured public_base_url
settings numeric constants are not measured plugin RAM capacity
parseStreamRange is QoS bookkeeping; final HTTP is Go ServeContent, not SPEC range policy
